selection_method: All six photos visually inspected before model predictions: one street scene with traffic and pedestrians, one near bus and pedestrians, close parked bicycles, backlit people with bicycles, pedestrian bridge, and pedestrian signal. No image chosen or removed based on prediction. All selected photos must be retained in the evaluation, including missing or incorrect detections. No synthetic image and no crop.
measurement_note: Distances are model estimates only; there is no physical ground truth, camera calibration or verified capture scale. Manual visible_elements are qualitative visual notes, not an exhaustive object annotation or a required model output.
